result:
All 14 queries ran and gave sensible answers on the input files. I checked U2, U7 and U9 by hand against the data. U1, U3–U6, U8, U10 and U11–U14 I only eyeballed against the files.

Two things you might not expect:
- In U9, the printed map has keyword keys (`:tools`, `:toys`, `:decor`), which is how qlang shows map keys.
- In U12, the result for each user comes from sorting by `ts` and taking the last event, which is the greatest `ts`.

U1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | ne null) | filter ~(/address | at :city | ne null) | filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
U2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
U3: filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)
U4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
U5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:assignee (/0 | keyword) :count /1}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3
U6: map ~(at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort
U7: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(count | gt 4) | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | take (count | sub 2) | parseJson) | avg | round 1
U8: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(count | gt 4) | groupBy ~(/2) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:p (/0 | keyword) :n /1}) | sort ~([(/n | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p)
U9: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | map ~({:c (/1 | lower) :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/c) | map ~(map ~(/p) | avg | round 2)
U10: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | ne 0) | map ~({:n /0 :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) | take 3 | map ~(/n)
U11: :d /defaults | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :s /1}) | filter ~(/s | at :enabled | coalesce (d | /enabled) | ne false) | map ~({:name /name :port (/s | at :port | coalesce (d | /port))}) | sort ~(/name)
U12: sort ~(/ts) | groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(last | /type)
U13: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | eq false) | map ~(split "|" | map ~(trim)) | filter ~(/2 | split "," | map ~(lower) | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | upper) | sort | join ","
U14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","fig","Elderberry","cherry","Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | :w / | {:count count :longest (w | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | take 2)}
